categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Has the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and directly modifies ZMQ initialization and notification interfaces in src/zmq/.
categories.rationale: Prevents bitcoind from silently running without ZMQ notifications when a configured socket fails to bind. As noted in issue #33715, bind failures were previously swallowed in debug logs, leaving node operators unaware that configured notifications were completely disabled.

categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Excluded by the category definition: the error handling and logging changes in src/init.cpp serve ZMQ-specific behavior rather than shared infrastructure.
categories.rationale: Changes to startup sequencing in src/init.cpp merely propagate ZMQ initialization errors, which falls under the ZMQ area rather than general utilities.
